rationale: The app-size and free-space limits retain at least 500 KiB in the fixed 4 MiB CardMind partition. The Architect decisions of 2026-09-22 allocate 12 KiB of the former 512 KiB reserve to the measured request-memory, search-command and pending-name corrections, leaving 3,584 bytes below the app cap on the coherent candidate. Section limits detect anomalous growth: rodata, DRAM and IRAM retain approximately 30 percent over the v1.12.0 baseline, while flash text accommodates the measured Phase 6 release-candidate ELF plus a 40 KiB guard and the v1.12.0 baseline still supplies growth warnings. The linker remains the final authority for SoC memory-region capacity.
